name: Canvas
summary: A design document drawn from data: frames with their names above them, and rectangles, ellipses and text inside, at a zoom, in a surface that scrolls both ways. Pressing a shape selects it; the selected one shows the accent outline, corner handles and its size. For an editor's working area or a preview of a layout drawn as boxes. Not for charts (StackedBar) or pictures (Image).
a11y: The canvas is a labelled, focusable scroll region. Each shape is a button named by its kind and name with `aria-pressed` for the selection, so it can be reached and chosen without a pointer; a frame's name above it is a button for the frame. The size under a selection is text. Shapes' colours carry no meaning of their own.

props.name: label
props.description: Names the canvas: the file's or page's name.

props.name: selected
props.description: The selected shape's id: drawn with the accent outline, its handles and its size.

props.name: onSelect
props.description: A shape was chosen; `undefined` when the empty canvas was pressed.

props.name: zoom
props.description: 1 is 100 %. Scales the document, not the canvas's own chrome (names, handles, size).

props.name: width
props.description: The document's extent in its own units, so the canvas can scroll to every shape.

props.name: size
props.description: `fill` takes the room its parent gives it (an editor's working area); `md` holds a set height (a demonstration).

props.name: label
props.description: Its name, as in the layers: "Header", "Sign in button". Names it for assistive technology.

props.name: x
props.description: Position and size in the document's own units (CSS pixels at 100 %), relative to its frame or the canvas.

props.name: text
props.description: The words of a text shape.

props.name: category
props.description: A rectangle's or ellipse's fill: one of the eight category colours (1–8). None: the raised surface.

props.name: children
props.description: The shapes inside a frame, positioned from its top-left corner.

props.name: look
props.description: How the document draws it, as a design tool's inspector sets it (F15.T2): the document's own values, not the UI's.

props.name: image
props.description: A picture's address, drawn over the fill (an image fill); `imageFit` `cover` (the default) crops it to the shape, `contain` shows all of it, `tile` repeats it at its own size.

props.name: stroke
props.description: An inside stroke, `#rrggbb`, with its weight in document units.

props.name: hidden
props.description: Hidden in the document (still listed in the layers).
